determinism.observed: Both builds produced the identical member hash f99a314b and zip digest lAt/vc4X. The after-planes agree. THREE INSTRUMENT FAILURES OF MINE WERE CAUGHT AND CORRECTED, none of them reaching a report. FIRST AND WORST: my shell helper printed its human-readable summary AND the status code to stdout, so command substitution captured the whole blob and my N3 guard compared it against '200', found it unequal, and announced a rollback -- while the output beside it read 'FUNCTION STATUS 200 / SERVED'. Acting on that guard would have rolled back a CORRECT release on a false reading, on my own authority and without waiting for any seat. I re-read the statuses from the response files alone and confirmed the live digest is still the new build. SECOND: a hand-typed log --start-time four hours in the future, returning a clean 0. THIRD: an unquoted hyphenated CloudWatch filter pattern, returning a clean 0 in a correct window -- the tool's trap, not mine, and row S51. A rollback trigger must be computed from a value, never from a captured transcript.
